newsitem.title: USA: Hayes Wheels gets Alfa Romeo contract.
newsitem.headline: Hayes Wheels gets Alfa Romeo contract.

text.p: Hayes Wheels International Inc said it has received a contract from Fiat SpA to supply cast aluminum wheels for the Alfa Romeo 145 and 146 passenger cars, beginning with the 1997 model year.
A value of the contract was not disclosed.
The wheels are being produced at Hayes Wheels' manufacturing facility in Campiglione, Italy, for shipment to the Alfa Romeo assembly plant in Pomigliano d'Arco, Italy.
Hayes Wheels designs and makes steel and aluminum wheels and brake drums and rotors for the automotive and commercial highway markets in North America, Europe and Asia.
Shares of Hayes Wheels were trading unchanged at 23-1/4.
